exposure: fetal middle cerebral artery (MCA) pulsatility index (PI)
outcome: admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
finding: Measuring CPR at 30-34 weeks' gestation provided a significant contribution to the prediction of arterial cord blood pH <= 7.0, venous cord blood pH <= 7.1 and admission to NNU, but the performance of CPR in routine screening for adverse perinatal outcome at 30-34 weeks' gestation is poor.
